record_scope_reconstruction: Taftan–Mirjaveh road passenger/cargo terminal; returning Pakistani pilgrims/citizens and later screened Iranian trucks have distinct endpoints. Railway excluded.

source_checks.finding: Radio Pakistan says over 300 citizens, including pilgrims/traders/labourers, entered through Taftan by late previous night with screening/quarantine.
Radio Pakistan reports 35-plus goods/LPG vehicles permitted through Taftan with Iranian-driver screening after initial cargo suspension.
